lines.zh: 弓背在肩上，我沿箭塔的梯子往上。
lines.en: Bow on my back, I climb the tower ladder.

lines.zh: 每一步踩实，栏杆外就是岩浆。
lines.en: Each step planted; lava waits past the rail.

lines.zh: 我绕着垛口走，数清每个射界。
lines.en: I circle the crenellations, counting every firing line.

lines.zh: 轻装跑得快，我习惯先占高处。
lines.en: Light gear runs fast; I take the high ground first.

lines.zh: 箭袋在腰后晃，羽毛蹭着甲。
lines.en: My quiver sways behind me, fletching brushing armor.

lines.zh: 窄梯只容半只脚，我扶着墙。
lines.en: The stair fits half a foot; I hold the wall.

lines.zh: 换到西塔，那边风小一些。
lines.en: To the west tower; the wind is weaker there.

lines.zh: 走过吊桥，木板响得很厉害。
lines.en: The plank bridge groans under each step.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，从垛口后面绕。
lines.en: I keep low and slip behind the parapet.

lines.zh: 走到塔顶，先看远处有没有烟。
lines.en: At the top, I check the horizon for smoke.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻，别惊了下面的猎物。
lines.en: Soft steps; I won't spook what's below.

lines.zh: 沿着墙根巡一圈，再回射位。
lines.en: One lap along the base, then back to my post.

lines.zh: 用拇指试弓弦，还是紧的。
lines.en: I test the string with my thumb; still taut.

lines.zh: 把箭一支支立起来数。
lines.en: I stand my arrows up and count them.

lines.zh: 风向变了，我把弓稍微偏一点。
lines.en: The wind shifted; I tilt the bow a little.

lines.zh: 塔下有人搬箱子，声音传上来。
lines.en: Someone shifts crates below; the sound rises.

lines.zh: 擦掉箭头上的旧血，等它干。
lines.en: I wipe old blood off a head and let it dry.

lines.zh: 把断了的箭杆折短，还能用。
lines.en: I snap a broken shaft shorter; still usable.

lines.zh: 盯着对面的窗口，看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at the far window for a long while.

lines.zh: 手指在弦上磨出茧，不疼了。
lines.en: Callus on my fingers; the string no longer hurts.

lines.zh: 听见号角，我抬头又低下。
lines.en: A horn sounds; I look up, then down again.

lines.zh: 把烟花插在垛口，引线朝外。
lines.en: I set a rocket on the ledge, fuse facing out.

lines.zh: 数塔有几层，数到七就乱。
lines.en: I count the tower's floors and lose it at seven.

lines.zh: 靠着石墙歇一会儿，眼不闭。
lines.en: I rest against the stone, eyes open.

lines.zh: 弓臂上有一道旧裂，我摸了摸。
lines.en: An old crack in the limb; I run a finger over it.

lines.zh: 听风吹过箭羽，像有人吹口哨。
lines.en: Wind through fletching sounds like someone whistling.

lines.zh: 把弓弦松一格，听见轻响。
lines.en: I ease the string a notch and hear it settle.

lines.zh: 塔下的火盆，照着我的靴尖。
lines.en: The brazier below lights my boot tips.

lines.zh: 我数着上楼的脚步，一共四。
lines.en: I count steps on the stair. Four of them.

lines.zh: 对岸的烟升起来，不是我们的。
lines.en: Smoke rises across the way. Not ours.

lines.zh: 你站在射界里，自己知道吗？
lines.en: You're standing in my firing line. Know it?

lines.zh: 手别往背后伸，我看得见。
lines.en: Keep your hand from your back; I can see it.

lines.zh: 抬起头，让我看清你的脸。
lines.en: Lift your head; let me see your face.

lines.zh: 你的披风颜色太亮，很好瞄。
lines.en: That cloak is too bright; easy to aim at.

lines.zh: 我数三个数，你就该走了。
lines.en: I count to three; by then you should be gone.

lines.zh: 别躲在柱子后，那木头挡不住箭。
lines.en: That pillar won't stop an arrow; don't hide there.

lines.zh: 你是来找人的，还是来送东西的？
lines.en: Are you here for someone, or to deliver something?

lines.zh: 站那么直，像靶子。
lines.en: Standing that straight, you look like a target.

lines.zh: 我认得你靴子的样式，外来货。
lines.en: I know those boots; foreign make.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，我就要拉弦了。
lines.en: One more step and I draw.

lines.zh: 你眼睛一直看我的箭袋。
lines.en: Your eyes keep drifting to my quiver.

lines.zh: 别朝塔上挥手，下面的人会误会。
lines.en: Don't wave at the tower; those below will misread it.

lines.zh: 弦被撞歪了，得重新调。
lines.en: The string's knocked crooked; I must retune.

lines.zh: 肩上一热，箭差点脱手。
lines.en: Heat in my shoulder; the arrow nearly slips.

lines.zh: 别打弓，打我可以。
lines.en: Hit me, not the bow.

lines.zh: 我退到垛口后，先看伤口。
lines.en: I duck behind the parapet and check the wound.

lines.zh: 这一下让我瞄偏了半寸。
lines.en: That made me aim half an inch off.

lines.zh: 血顺着手腕流到弦上。
lines.en: Blood runs down my wrist onto the string.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙把箭重新搭上。
lines.en: I bite down and nock another arrow.

lines.zh: 叫一声会引来更多人。
lines.en: A cry would only bring more of them.

lines.zh: 腿有点软，但还站得住。
lines.en: My legs feel weak, but I'm standing.

lines.zh: 这笔账记在弦上。
lines.en: I'll settle this debt from the string.

lines.zh: 那捆羽毛给我，箭尾正缺。
lines.en: Hand me those feathers; my nocks need them.

lines.zh: 你袋里有燧石，我看见了。
lines.en: Flint in your bag; I saw it.

lines.zh: 金锭放在垛口上，别递过来。
lines.en: Leave the gold on the ledge; don't hand it over.

lines.zh: 线团留着，我自己缠弓弦。
lines.en: Keep the string; I wind my own.

lines.zh: 你带火药？那能换两支箭。
lines.en: You have gunpowder? That's worth two arrows.

lines.zh: 这包糖我收，塞箭袋里不占地方。
lines.en: I'll take the sugar; it fits in my quiver.

lines.zh: 别晃那根木棍，我会当成弓坯。
lines.en: Don't wave that stick; I'll mistake it for a bow stave.

lines.zh: 你把铁锭搁下，我就当没看见你。
lines.en: Set the iron down and I'll pretend I didn't see you.

lines.zh: 那支断箭你留着没用，给我。
lines.en: That broken arrow is useless to you; give it here.

lines.zh: 换东西可以，别想换我的位置。
lines.en: Trade if you like, but not for my post.

lines.zh: 别挤，我脚下就是空。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; there's nothing under my feet.

lines.zh: 你撞歪了我的箭袋。
lines.en: You knocked my quiver crooked.

lines.zh: 让路，我要去垛口那边。
lines.en: Make way; I need the far crenel.

lines.zh: 轻点，弓臂经不起磕。
lines.en: Careful; the bow limb can't take a knock.

lines.zh: 两个人过不了这道梯口。
lines.en: Two can't pass this stair mouth.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的弦了，抬脚。
lines.en: You're on my string; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 我往后退，你别再顶过来。
lines.en: I'll step back; don't push again.

lines.zh: 肩膀碰一下，箭都歪了。
lines.en: One shoulder bump and my arrows skewed.

lines.zh: 这里风大，站稳再说话。
lines.en: The wind is strong here; steady yourself first.

lines.zh: 别贴墙走，那侧石头松。
lines.en: Don't hug that wall; the stone's loose.

lines.zh: 你射左，我射右，别抢同一个。
lines.en: You take left, I take right; don't both aim.

lines.zh: 你的弓弦松了，我替你换。
lines.en: Your string's gone slack; let me rewind it.

lines.zh: 我打第一支，你补第二支。
lines.en: I loose the first; you follow with the second.

lines.zh: 看见烟花，你就知道我在哪。
lines.en: When you see my rocket, you'll know where I am.

lines.zh: 共用一个箭袋，省得来回跑。
lines.en: We share one quiver so nobody runs back.

lines.zh: 你守夜，我睡两个时辰。
lines.en: You take the night watch; I sleep two hours.

lines.zh: 同一条弦上练出来的手。
lines.en: Our hands were trained on the same string.

lines.zh: 你受伤了就先退，我压住他们。
lines.en: If you're hit, fall back; I'll pin them down.

lines.zh: 两支箭并排插着，是我们的记号。
lines.en: Two arrows side by side mark our spot.

lines.zh: 哪天不打仗了，去下面看岩浆。
lines.en: When the fighting ends, let's watch the lava below.

lines.zh: 箭落在地上还能捡回来。
lines.en: An arrow on the ground can still be reclaimed.

lines.zh: 捡到半支断箭，留着修。
lines.en: Half an arrow; I'll keep it for repairs.

lines.zh: 谁丢的羽毛，正好补箭尾。
lines.en: Someone's lost feathers; perfect for nocks.

lines.zh: 这枚箭头卷了，也得收着。
lines.en: This head is bent, but I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 弯腰去捡，眼睛还看着对面。
lines.en: I bend to pick it up, eyes still on the far side.

lines.zh: 捡到一截弦，比我现在的粗。
lines.en: A length of string, thicker than mine.

lines.zh: 别踩那支箭，我还没收。
lines.en: Don't step on that arrow; I haven't collected it.

lines.zh: 地上的木片，能削成新箭杆。
lines.en: That splinter on the floor can become a shaft.

lines.zh: 我一根根插回箭袋里。
lines.en: I slide them back into the quiver one by one.

lines.zh: 这袋金粒不归我，放回原处。
lines.en: These nuggets aren't mine; back they go.

lines.zh: 塔下有人影，我拉开半步弓。
lines.en: A shape below the tower; I half-draw.

lines.zh: 他背着盾，先射腿。
lines.en: He carries a shield; I aim for the legs.

lines.zh: 风把他衣角吹起来，我看见轮廓。
lines.en: The wind lifts his coat; I see his outline.

lines.zh: 有人碰了警报线，我听见铃响。
lines.en: Someone brushed the alarm wire; I hear the bell.

lines.zh: 他躲在箱后，但箱子太矮。
lines.en: He hides behind a crate, but the crate's short.

lines.zh: 那个戴头盔的走得最前。
lines.en: The one in the helmet walks ahead of the rest.

lines.zh: 他从侧门进来，绕过了岗哨。
lines.en: He came through the side door, past the sentries.

lines.zh: 影子在墙上动，比人慢半拍。
lines.en: A shadow moves on the wall, half a beat late.

lines.zh: 他点火把了，位置全暴露。
lines.en: He lit a torch; now everyone sees him.

lines.zh: 有人想爬箭塔，梯子在响。
lines.en: Someone's on the ladder; it's creaking.

lines.zh: 吸气到一半，手指就松。
lines.en: Half a breath in, and my fingers release.

lines.zh: 让箭头挡住他，别挡月亮。
lines.en: Line the head on him, not on the moon.

lines.zh: 他跑得直，正好省一支箭。
lines.en: He runs straight; that saves me an arrow.

lines.zh: 等风停，就这一瞬。
lines.en: Wait for the wind to drop; just this instant.

lines.zh: 算好落点，箭会往下坠。
lines.en: I allow for the drop; the arrow falls.

lines.zh: 他往左偏，我提前半格。
lines.en: He leans left; I lead him half a mark.

lines.zh: 别急，够近了再放。
lines.en: Not yet; let him come closer.

lines.zh: 看清他有没有甲，再决定射哪。
lines.en: See if he's armored before choosing where to hit.

lines.zh: 箭搭上去，弦贴着脸颊。
lines.en: Arrow nocked; the string touches my cheek.

lines.zh: 他抬头了，正好。
lines.en: He looks up; perfect.

lines.zh: 弓当棍子使，砸他的手腕。
lines.en: I swing the bow like a club at his wrist.

lines.zh: 箭用完了，只能贴身打。
lines.en: Out of arrows; now it's close work.

lines.zh: 用弓角顶他喉咙，逼他后退。
lines.en: I jam the bow's tip at his throat and push.

lines.zh: 抓住他的弓，两人一起滚。
lines.en: I grab his bow and we both go down.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在肩上，他手松了。
lines.en: A blow to the shoulder; his grip opens.

lines.zh: 我用空箭袋抽他的脸。
lines.en: I lash his face with an empty quiver.

lines.zh: 他近身，我反而更稳。
lines.en: At close range I'm steadier.

lines.zh: 把他往垛口外顶。
lines.en: I shoulder him toward the open ledge.

lines.zh: 弓弦勒住他的手，别让他拔刀。
lines.en: The string bites his hand; no drawing a blade.

lines.zh: 他退到墙边，我补了一脚。
lines.en: He backs to the wall; I add a kick.

lines.zh: 塔顶的风第一次吹到脸上。
lines.en: Tower wind hits my face for the first time.

lines.zh: 有人把弓放进我手里，没说话。
lines.en: Someone puts a bow in my hands and says nothing.

lines.zh: 我在垛口边醒来，箭袋是满的。
lines.en: I wake at the crenel with a full quiver.

lines.zh: 下面的黑石被火照得发红。
lines.en: The blackstone below glows red in the firelight.

lines.zh: 领到的第一支箭，我插在墙上。
lines.en: I plant my first arrow in the wall.

lines.zh: 这层塔的守卫昨晚没回来。
lines.en: This tower's guard didn't return last night.

lines.zh: 远处的号角响了三声，我记住。
lines.en: Three horn calls far off; I memorize them.

lines.zh: 从梯子下往上爬，手一直抖。
lines.en: Climbing the ladder, my hands keep shaking.

lines.zh: 他们说我跑得快，适合守高塔。
lines.en: They say I'm fast; that suits a high tower.

lines.zh: 我把烟花放在脚边，先熟悉它。
lines.en: I set the rocket by my feet and learn it.

lines.zh: 风从岩浆那边来，带着焦味。
lines.en: Wind from the lava, carrying a burnt smell.

lines.zh: 第一眼看到的，是整片红色天。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a whole red sky.

lines.zh: 羽毛烧卷了，箭飞不稳。
lines.en: Burnt fletching; the arrow won't fly true.

lines.zh: 从塔上摔下来，弓先落地。
lines.en: I fall from the tower; the bow lands first.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我却在往下沉。
lines.en: No water here, yet I'm sinking.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推离了垛口。
lines.en: The blast shoves me off the crenel.

lines.zh: 他们的箭，和我的一样快。
lines.en: Their arrows fly as fast as mine.

lines.zh: 有股力扯我的弦，不听使唤。
lines.en: Something pulls my string out of my control.

lines.zh: 手抖得拉不满弓。
lines.en: My hands shake too much to draw full.

lines.zh: 雷劈在塔尖，弓身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the spire; the bow tingles.

lines.zh: 底下没有黑石，只有空。
lines.en: No blackstone below; only nothing.
